title: Vulgate
summary: VULGATE, noun A very ancient Latin version of the scriptures, one the only one which the Romish church admits to be authentic. It is so called from its common use in the Latin church. VULGATE, adjecti

inlines.v: VULGATE, noun A very ancient Latin version of the scriptures, one the only one which the Romish church admits to be authentic. It is so called from its common use in the Latin church. VULGATE, adjective Pertaining to the old Latin version of the scriptures.
